result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the featured 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card shows a broken-image placeholder instead of its actual photo.

issues.description: The large image card for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' under 'Popular right now' displays a generic broken-image placeholder icon instead of the actual restaurant photo, unlike the properly rendered images in the 'Fastest near you' row.
issues.suggestion: Load a valid restaurant image, or add a graceful fallback (e.g., branded placeholder graphic) and investigate why the image asset failed to load.
